rationale: The discourse has stabilized into a well-defined impasse: labour and the state hold firm on no closures and no compulsory redundancies, while management, owners, and investors insist on closure-equivalent savings and keep structural options alive. Round 3 added clearer economic framing, but no party materially shifted on the core conflict, so further unguided rounds are unlikely to resolve it without a higher-level mediation or quantified scenario exercise.
